title: cxt Manifest v1 — repository metadata index
description: Catalog of a repository's refs and snapshot index. It supports push/pull negotiation, missing-object calculation, and optimistic locking through version. This is the serialized domain.Manifest form.

repo_id.description: The ID of the repo this manifest belongs to (normalized remote URL or cwd fallback hash).

refs.description: All mutable repository pointers (HEAD/branch/session/tag), unique by (kind,name).

snapshot_index.description: Snapshot IDs held by this store (content hashes). Push/pull computes the remote difference and transfers only missing objects.

memory_attachments.description: Current causal memory hash keyed by snapshot ID. Omitted by legacy peers that do not advertise attachment state.

snapshot_states.description: Deterministic hash of mutable replicated state (branch/message promotion, memory attachment, and graft register) keyed by snapshot ID. A complete map enables incremental metadata pulls; omission means a legacy peer and requires a full metadata pull.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version for optimistic locking. Writes compare it with the version observed at read time (CAS).

updated_at.description: Last update time of the manifest (RFC3339).

contentHash.description: Content-addressed hash in 'sha256:<hex>' format. Identical content produces the same deduplication key.

refKind.description: Ref type: head=current checkout symbolic ref, branch=actual Git branch pointer, session=preserved pointer within the same Git branch, tag=immutable label (including reserved cxt/branch-state/v1 lifecycle events).

ref.description: HEAD/branch/session pointers or immutable tags serialized from domain.Ref. Reserved cxt/branch-state/v1 tags preserve branch archive/restore events without deleting history.

name.description: Ref name. A branch uses the Git branch name, a session uses an internal session name, a tag uses its tag name, and HEAD is fixed at 'HEAD'. The cxt/branch-state/v1 tag namespace is reserved.

target.description: Referenced Snapshot.ID, or an empty string for symbolic HEAD.

symbolic.description: Optional symbolic target. Set it to the branch name when HEAD points to a branch; leave it empty for a direct snapshot pointer.

then.description: If kind=head, name is fixed to 'HEAD'.
